data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's prior-year claims reserves (gross) showed a small net release in 2019 of approximately GBP 2.96m (around 0.31% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 956.51m). The gross claims development triangle indicates modest favourable development across several older underwriting years, outweighing some adverse movement in mid-years. The movement note in the accounts presents a net prior-year surplus (net of reinsurance) of GBP 4.6m; the gross triangle based analysis (used here) gives a small gross release. 2019 did incur catastrophe losses (notably Hurricane Dorian, typhoons in Japan and US winter storms) but these are presented as current-year catastrophe activity and net of reinsurance amounted to GBP 10.2m.
raw_causal_phrases: The prior year's net provision for claims outstanding generated a surplus for 2019 (2018: surplus) as detailed below:
the syndicate's reported profit benefitted from a prior period reserve release of GBP 4.6 million compared to a release of GBP 21.0 million in 2018.
Net catastrophe related losses, primarily relating to Hurricane Dorian and US winter storms amounted to GBP 10.2 million and were commensurate with the syndicate's risk tolerances and expectations.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Technical provisions - Claims outstanding) 2018 comparative column. Prior-year development calculated from the GROSS claims development triangle (claims development table) on page 48. NOTE: the claims development table includes data relating to Syndicate 1882 which was reinsured and closed into Syndicate 2488 with effect 1 January 2019 (RITC), which can distort the triangle; the Managing Agent's movement note on page 38 reports only NET prior-year movements by class (net of reinsurance). Where class-level movements are reported they are net figures; lob_movements above are mapped from that net table and flagged with reduced confidence. Because the movement note provides only net figures by class, and the triangle is affected by RITC, there is some uncertainty in the gross prior-year movement estimate.
